page_title: FRO 3-1 CAG | Frosinone v Cagliari 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

90+5' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Nadir Zortea plays the ball to the feet of Kaio Jorge (Frosinone), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 3:1.
90+5' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Bonifazi (Frosinone) will replace Francesco Gelli.
90+4' Federico Dionisi shows a yellow card to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
90+3' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) attempts to head the rebound inside the right post, but Stefano Turati reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
90+3' Cagliari get a corner.
90+3' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) was probably a bit loose with his words to Federico Dionisi, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+2' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cagliari.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The free kick into the box finds Alberto Dossena (Cagliari), who heads the ball towards the left post, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
89' Cagliari have been awarded an indirect mid-range free kick.
87' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico Dionisi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
86' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
85' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
84' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
83' The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.

82' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
81' The substitution has been made. Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) has replaced Matias Soule.
80' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
78' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Federico Dionisi ignores the protests.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Matteo Prati.
75' 2 - 1 Matias Soule (Frosinone) sets the ball for the free kick and fires in a beautiful strike, which nestles exactly in the top right corner.
74' Frosinone are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Federico Dionisi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' That's the end of the game for Nicolas Viola, who is replaced by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
72' Substitution. Mateusz Wieteska leaves the pitch and is replaced by Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Petagna leaves the pitch and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on.

69' A cross to the edge of the box finds Matias Soule (Frosinone) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with quick shot towards the bottom left corner. Simone Scuffet pulls off a good save and the score remains the same.

68' This was a nice set play that lacked a finish. Unmarked Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick and unleashed a long-range shot. He hit the ball very poorly, sending it into the stands.
67' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.

64' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Abdou Harroui and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
63' Good work from Frosinone as they win a corner.
62' What was Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
60' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Reinier is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone).
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) for Walid Cheddira.
59' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul.
57' The referee can't ignore those comments and Matias Soule (Frosinone) sees a yellow card for bad language.
56' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
55' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
53' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
52' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.

51' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the right post!
50' Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
49' The free kick from close range, taken by Cagliari, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
48' Federico Dionisi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Caleb Okoli (Frosinone).
47' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) and Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+8' A great solo effort from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot towards the middle of the goal. Stefano Turati has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
45+8' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

45+7' A player from Cagliari commits a rough challenge. Federico Dionisi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Frosinone, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45+5' The goal by Frosinone is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
45+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Frosinone players aren’t happy.
45+1' Goal! Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Great play by Reinier releases Matias Soule (Frosinone) who decides to shoot from distance, but he balloons it high over the bar.

42' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Simone Scuffet makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
39' The game is interrupted. Matias Soule (Frosinone) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
38' A crossfield pass from Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
37' Simone Scuffet (Cagliari) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
33' Cagliari will take a free kick.
33' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle. Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) commits a foul after dangerous play.
30' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

26' 0 - 1 Goal! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Stefano Turati is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.
25' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' What a big chance! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
22' Matias Soule (Frosinone) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Federico Dionisi shows a yellow card to Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
19' Cagliari will take a corner kick.
18' A goal, which was scored by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone), was disallowed due to offside.
17' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
16' The ball goes out for a corner. Frosinone can continue in their attacking effort.
16' Reinier (Frosinone) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
13' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
8' The game is interrupted now, Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
6' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
4' The linesman points to the corner flag, Frosinone are going to take it.
3' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Federico Dionisi.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
